text:
You need someone who can engage potential clients and present AI products clearly while helping drive sales growth.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my background is on the analytics side, I’ve spent that time turning raw sales data into clear, decision-ready reporting that supports sales teams and helps them communicate performance with confidence.

One project I completed was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a major simplification of their reporting process, and monthly close reporting moved from 3 days to 4 hours. That work required structured thinking, clean presentation, and the ability to translate complex information into something easy to understand and act on.

That same approach is useful in a sales role for AI products. Selling new technology requires more than product knowledge; it requires listening carefully, explaining value clearly, and presenting information in a way that makes sense to each potential client. My experience building dashboards and reports has trained me to organize information, communicate it well, and focus on what matters most to the audience in front of me.

I would be glad to bring that mindset to your team and help support sales conversations, product presentation, and client engagement for your AI offerings. I’m comfortable working with data, understanding performance trends, and using that insight to support stronger sales discussions.

What kind of AI products will I be representing, and who is the primary target customer?
